Decisions/meetings link to in-page anchors (#overview-decisions, #overview-meetings, both already-existing or newly-id'd panels); reviews links to /?work=review&filter=overdue; permits links to /?lens=development-services&tab=pipeline&filter=active. Verified by real click in headless Chromium: clicking Permits in flight navigated the URL and lit up #lens-development-services with class 'lens on'. filter threads through resolveStaffLensQuery (new field, raw passthrough) and applyLens (root.setAttribute('data-filter', ...)); Not read word values and basis text are byte-identical to origin/main.
implementation.item2_acrossDepartments: New section#overview-departments, 3-col grid (2-col at 1180px, 1-col at 900px, matching the file's existing breakpoints -- no new breakpoints invented), exactly the 6 named departments, each card honestly 'no source connected' by default (matches Empty.dc.html verbatim; template-city and empty-city both render this by construction, since neither grants a real adapter). New CSS: deptsection, deptsection-head, deptgrid, deptcard (4 new selectors + reuses .rail/.nm/.basis already defined).
implementation.item3_connectionsPromoteDemote: New panel#overview-connections: lead paragraph (quiet-explainer, matches Empty.dc.html's copy verbatim), count badge, 5 srcreg rows (reuses the existing .srcreg row component verbatim -- zero new CSS for the rows). Static default position is promoted (immediately after #overview-metrics), matching the honest-empty shape every city ships with. New app.js function placeOverviewConnections(sources), called from applyIdentity where nav-sources/nav-demonstrated already render, moves the panel to just above #overview-source-register and hides the lead paragraph once granted > 0.
implementation.item3_realBugCaughtAndFixed: First draft keyed the promote/demote decision on sources.demonstrated (fixture-generation count) rather than sources.granted (real-adapter count), on the reasoning that a demo pack 'reads' its own generated records. Live-checked at source (curl against the local dev server's /api/city-identity) before trusting it: template-city returns granted:0, demonstrated:6 (generatesFixtures:true -- it is the product's own public DEMO pack, not the honest-empty one; a second shipped pack is granted:0, demonstrated:0 by design so the empty states stay reachable). Every other figure on Overview -- the 4 tiles, the across-departments grid, this same panel's own row pills -- answers off grantedAdapters and is honestly empty on the demo pack regardless of its generated records. The demonstrated-keyed version would have demoted Connections on the product's own primary dev/demo target while every sibling panel on the same load still read empty -- a page visibly disagreeing with itself. Fixed to key on granted; added a dedicated regression test (src/ui.test.mjs, sliced-and-executed against the real function via vm, same pattern as src/lens-claims.test.mjs's shippedResolver) asserting exactly this shape stays promoted.
implementation.item4_rightRail: Map region (#anchor-overview-map, the parcel/Demo fixture readout) left byte-for-byte untouched. Its own rendering is G-121, PINNED, not started.
implementation.item5_onTheMap: New panel#overview-located replaces the old 'Sources' panel (atoms-read/atoms-basis/atoms-summary, which surfaced raw atom-type vocabulary -- buildable-envelope, rrc-pipeline-fact, setback-rule). Ships the honest-empty state only (matches Empty.dc.html verbatim); the dead atom-type display code in composeGoldMap (web/app.js) is deleted, not left unreachable. No located-records source exists in this repo (grepped every domain generator for an address field: none); wiring one is left open, stated in findings below.
implementation.cssGates: shell.css declares no :root, no hex, no rgb()/rgba() outside comments -- every new rule uses var(--sc-*) only (grepped web/shell.css for hex/rgb literals after editing: none introduced). No new font-size/weight combination invented -- every new selector's font: line is copied verbatim from an existing selector doing the same job (e.g. deptcard .nm b copies .srcreg .nm b's exact declaration). 5 new classes (metriclink, deptsection, deptsection-head, deptgrid, deptcard), each defined in web/shell.css and asserted by src/ui.test.mjs's own new test; the pre-existing G-90 class-count pin (src/shell-parity.test.mjs) updated 182->187 with the same style of dated, named comment the file already uses for G-117's additions.
